Name: CP-A Warp Pad Obelisks
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
Replaces the obelisks with colourful warp pads inspired by Steven Universe!

[b]Configuration[/b]
Currently there are 20 different colours available. To choose a colour for each obelisk, run the game with the mod once, and then open the config.json to input one of the possible values. The mod contains a reference image with each colour option.

Currently the options are:
blue, gold, goldblue, green, kuromi, monochrome, mymelody, neon, olive, olivepink, pink, pinkyellow, primary, purple, red, retro, secondary, teal, tealorange, watermelon

You can replace all the obelisks including the one on Ginger Island.

[b]Requirements
[/b]Both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url] are required for this mod. It will not run without CP-A.

Let me know if you have any mod suggestions or there are any mistakes
